newsitem.title: USA: New York City police officer killed in ambush.
newsitem.headline: New York City police officer killed in ambush.

text.p: An off-duty New York City police officer working as a security guard in a check cashing store and the shop's owner were killed in a holdup on Saturday morning, police said.

Officer Sam Davis, 38, and Ira Epstein, the owner of the store were ambushed at 7 a.m. EST (1200 GMT) as they entered the business to open it in the city's borough of Queens near LaGuardia Airport, police said.
"They were confronted by three suspects and both victims were shot numerous times. It appears to be a robbery," a police spokeswoman said.
Epstein died at the scene. The officer was pronounced dead an hour after the shooting at a hospital. Davis, an eight-year veteran on the force, leaves a wife and young daughter.
Police said they have no further identification on the gunmen.
